settings.name_in_paper: Personalized federated multi-armed bandits (PF-MAB) with mixed learning objective
unmapped: N = M clients with heterogeneous (non-IID) local models over the same K arms
Mixed reward X'_{k,m} = alpha X_{k,m} + (1-alpha) X_k with global reward X_k the average of local rewards; global reward not directly observable (partially observable reward)
Client-server periodic communication with cost C_comm per client per communication slot added to regret
Personalization weight alpha in [0,1] known to the learner
Each client's optimal arm on its mixed model assumed unique
settings.definition_quote: R(T) = T\sum_{m=1}^M\mu'_{*,m}-\Eb\left[\sum_{t=1}^T\sum_{m=1}^MX'_{\pi_m(t),m}(t)\right]+CMT_c, where $\mu'_{*,m}$ is the mean reward from the optimal arm $k'_{*,m}$ of client $m$'s mixed model

symbols.sum_clients_subopt: sum over clients m=1..M and arms k != k'_{*,m} (suboptimal on client m's mixed model)
symbols.kl_Y_km: KL divergence kl(Y_{k,m}, Y_{k'_{*,m},m}) with Y_{k,m} = (alpha+(1-alpha)/M) X_{k,m} + mu'_{k,m} - (alpha+(1-alpha)/M) mu_{k,m}
symbols.kl_Z_km_min: min over n != m with k'_{*,n} != k of kl(Z^m_{k,n}, Z^m_{k'_{*,n},n}), Z^m_{k,n} = (1-alpha)/M X_{k,m} + mu'_{k,n} - (1-alpha)/M mu_{k,m}

conditions: communication cost ignored (C=0); paper states bound still holds for C>0

source.label: thm:fed_lower
source.quote: For any consistent algorithm $\Pi$, the regret $R(T)$ in Eqn.~\eqref{eqn:regret_personal} can be lower bounded as \liminf_{T\to\infty}\frac{R_{\Pi}(T)}{\log(T)}\geq \sum_{m=1}^M\sum_{k\neq k'_{*,m}}\max\bigg\{...\bigg\}

results.notes: Regret includes communication term; defined through means so classified as pseudo-regret. Paper notes the bound is not tight in general.

symbols.sum_clients_subopt: sum over clients m and arms k != k'_{*,m}

source.label: col:fed_lower_gaussian
source.quote: For any consistent algorithm $\Pi$, if the rewards follow Gaussian distributions with unit variance, the regret is lower bounded as \liminf_{T\to\infty}\frac{R_{\Pi}(T)}{\log(T)}\geq \sum_{m=1}^M\sum_{k\neq k'_{*,m}}\max\bigg\{\frac{2\beta^2}{\Delta'_{k,m}}, \frac{2\gamma^2\Delta'_{k,m}}{(\Delta'_{k})^2}\bigg\}

results.notes: Gaussian special case of Theorem 1 with a different explicit expression.

symbols.sum_clients_subopt: sum over clients m and arms k != k'_{*,m}
symbols.L_loc_km: sum_{p=1}^{p'_{k,m}} ceil(alpha M f(p)), where p'_{k,m} is smallest integer with M F(p) >= 64 log(T)/Delta'_{k,m}^2, F(p)=sum_{q<=p} f(q)
symbols.G_glob_k: sum_{p=1}^{p'_k} ceil((1-alpha) f(p)), p'_k = max_m p'_{k,m}
symbols.X_expt_km: sum_{p=1}^{p'_{k,m}} K ceil(alpha M f(p)) exp(-Delta'_{k,m}^2 M F(p-1)/4)
symbols.C_comm: communication loss per communication slot per client

tuning: confidence bound B_p = sqrt(4 log(T)/(M F(p)))

source.label: col:regret_overall_log
source.quote: With $f(p)=2^p\log(T)$, it holds that R(T)= O\left(\sum_{m=1}^M\sum_{k\neq k'_{*,m}}\left[\frac{\alpha}{\Delta'_{k,m}}+\frac{\frac{1-\alpha}{M}\Delta'_{k,m}}{(\Delta'_{k})^2}\right]\log(T)\right), where $\Delta'_{k}=\min_{n:k'_{*,n}\neq k}\{\Delta'_{k,n}\}$.

results.notes: Communication and exploitation losses claimed O(1) (constant in T). Appendix Table 1 (not a formal statement) gives additional variants for f(p)=lambda, lambda log T, 2^p including communication terms; not recorded.
